source.label: Wizards event coverage, "2006 Vintage Championship: C-c-combo's a'comin'!" (Ted Knutson)

notes.text: Seeds from the coverage bracket, whose later rounds are blank. Semifinal Kolowith def. Kraehling and final Spero def. Kolowith are from the match coverage; Spero's quarterfinal and semifinal opponents follow from the bracket.
The page also carries 2005 champion Roland Chang's list, which is not a 2006 Top 8 list.
Date and venue from the Wizards fact sheet (Sunday, August 13, 2006, Indiana Convention Center).
The coverage bracket shows only the quarterfinal pairings and does not report Nicolo v Vroman; Vroman's quarterfinal win is from Stephen Menendian's StarCityGames wrap-up.
